ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (black pigment) to high-intensity (white/cream pigment) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation dominates the central and medial sections of both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white/cream fields are localized at the distal tips, featuring irregular black mottling and focal spots primarily along the transition boundaries between the white and black zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression visible with an approximate internal angle of 115 degrees and a medium depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge topography. Multiple high-frequency serrations (peaks and valleys) with amplitudes of 5-20 pixels. A significant deep indentation is visible on the upper margin of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge trailing from the median notch toward the distal tips; leading edges show a convex sweep toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, textured golden-white pixel clusters (circular/rosette morphology) are present at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicative of biological colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible on the dark pigmented area of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, deep semicircular notch or missing tissue section is located on the outer trailing edge of the right lobe lobe; significant calcified clusters are present on both lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, dark hook-shaped pigment mark is located within the white field of the right distal lobe tip.
